source.name: Triage
source.originalDescription: Increases movement speed by 25% when near ally Pokémon at 50% max HP or below. Stores up to 8 flowers; consumes all flowers when using Synthesis, Floral Healing, or Sweet Kiss while attached, boosting their effects. Gains 1 flower every 1.5s. Gains 4 flowers when entering tall grass while detached (5s CD). Attaches to a designated ally Pokémon when using Synthesis, Floral Healing, or Sweet Kiss while detached, granting a Triage shield effect to the ally based on Comfey's max HP. While attached: becomes untargetable, restores 1% max HP every 1s; takes Aeos energy gained in excess of the maximum the ally can hold, and scores the same amount of Aeos energy into a goal as the ally if not using a move while the ally channels the score. Detaches from the ally in the designated direction when the button to return to base is used (or a separate detach button on mobile). When detaching: removes the Triage shield effect from the ally; becomes invincible for 0.5s, and readies a boosted attack.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Triage は 無敵になる、対象指定されない、またはステルス状態になる、移動速度を上げる、HPを回復する、シールドを付与する、HP割合条件で発動する、味方へ付着または移動する、壁・地形・草むらなどと相互作用する。

source.name: Flowery Fields Forever
source.originalDescription: Briefly becomes unstoppable and creates a large area of tall grass around their location for 6s. Pokémon in this tall grass cannot be seen, just as with other tall grass on the map. Restores the HP of teammates in this Unite Move's tall grass every 0.5s. Gains special flowers from this tall grass, which grant access to an empowered use of Floral Healing or Sweet Kiss. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
